description: This file defines the web API endpoints for managing products in a minimal API approach. It includes CRUD operations: list, get by ID, create, update, and delete for 'Product' resources, with route configuration and metadata annotations.

classes.name: ProductEndpoints
classes.description: Static class providing extension method to map product-related API endpoints.

methods.name: MapProductEndpoints
methods.description: Configures and maps all CRUD endpoints for 'Product' resources to the provided IEndpointRouteBuilder.
